cards.text: Right before this, God's people pray for the LORD to tear open the heavens and come down, and they ask whether He will keep silent (Isaiah 64:1, 12). Now the LORD speaks. He starts with people who never asked for Him and never even looked for Him.

cards.question: The LORD talks about people who never asked for Him and never looked for Him. What does He do for them?

answers.text: He waits for them to ask first

cards.text: To a nation that didn't even call His name, He says, 'Here I am! Here I am!' Friend, after all my years in that junk drawer, I'd have CRIED if anybody said that to me just ONCE.

cards.question: All day long, the LORD holds out His hands to an obstinate people who walk in the wrong path. What does He say they follow?

cards.text: And the LORD says these people continually provoke Him to His face. Not behind His back, friend, RIGHT to His face.

cards.question: These people keep provoking the LORD. Where are they offering their sacrifices?

cards.text: It keeps going. They sit among the graves, spend nights in secret places, and eat the meat of pigs and polluted broth from their bowls.
Then they say, 'Keep to yourself; do not come near me, for I am holier than you!' That's somebody covered head to toe in cookie dough telling YOU to go wash up.

cards.question: These people say, 'Keep to yourself; do not come near me…' What does the LORD say people like that are to Him?
The LORD also says people like that are a fire that burns all day long.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, 'Behold, it is written before Me…'

cards.question: After all this, the LORD says He will keep silent.

cards.text: He says He will repay, right into their laps, both for their iniquities and for those of their fathers.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll repay these people. What does He say they did on the mountains and the hills?

answers.text: Hid their silver from the priests

cards.text: Then the LORD paints a picture: new wine found in a cluster of grapes. Men say to leave that cluster alone.

cards.question: In the LORD's picture, why do men say to leave a cluster of grapes with new wine in it alone?

cards.text: So the LORD says He will not destroy all His servants. He'll bring forth descendants from Jacob, whom God renamed Israel (Genesis 35:10), and heirs from Judah, one of Jacob's sons (Genesis 35:23).

cards.question: The LORD says His servants will dwell on His mountains.

cards.text: Then the LORD talks about the land. Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds.

cards.question: Sharon and the Valley of Achor will be for the LORD's people who ___ Him.

cards.text: Then the LORD turns to the ones who forsake Him and forget His holy mountain.

cards.question: The LORD talks about people who forsake Him and forget His holy mountain. Who does He say they set a table for?

cards.text: They also fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny, and like Fortune, Destiny is a false god. The LORD tells them, 'I will destine you for the sword, and you will all kneel down to be slaughtered…'

cards.question: Why does the LORD say the sword is coming for the ones who forsook Him?

answers.text: He called and they did not answer
They forgot to bring an offering

cards.text: Therefore the Lord GOD lays it out side by side: His servants on one side, the ones who forsook Him on the other. Same oven, friend, two VERY different batches.

cards.question: The Lord GOD says His servants will go hungry while the ones who forsook Him will eat.
The Lord GOD says His servants will rejoice. What happens to the ones who forsook Him?

answers.text: They will be put to shame

cards.text: His servants will shout for joy with a glad heart, the kind of LOUD that would wake up my whole bakery. The others will cry out with a heavy heart and wail with a broken spirit.
The ones who forsook the LORD will leave behind their name as a curse for His chosen ones. And the Lord GOD will slay them.

cards.question: The Lord GOD will give His servants another name.

cards.text: Whoever invokes a blessing or takes an oath in the land will do it by the God of truth.

cards.question: Blessings and oaths in the land will be by the God of truth, for the former troubles will be ___ and hidden from His sight.
